name: Sable Fix Core 1.4.0
body:
## v1.4.0 — Browser upgrades

- 🗂️ **Sublevel browser**: filter chips (All / Broken / Healthy) + sortable columns (name / size / dead slots, click again to flip direction) + mouse-wheel scrolling for long lists
- 🌐 6 new bilingual keys; language audit 131/131 green

## 中文
- 🗂️ **子层级浏览器**：过滤（全部/异常/健康）+ 排序（名称/大小/死槽，再点反向）+ 长列表滚轮翻页
